answer.summary: path-traversal (high): In src/files.py, read_public() concatenates the caller-supplied user_path directly onto root via (root / user_path).read_text() without resolving the result or verifying it remains under root. An attacker passing a value such as "../../etc/passwd" escapes the intended public-root boundary documented in README.md ("intended to serve files below one public root") and reads arbitrary files readable by the process. Exploit condition: any untrusted input reaches user_path. Fix: resolve the joined path and assert it is within root (e.g., Path(root / user_path).resolve().is_relative_to(root.resolve())) before reading.
